Privacy Policy

How we protect and use your information

Last Updated: December 2024

Introduction

Taunton Somerset Directory ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you visit our website tauntonsomerset.co.uk.

Information We Collect

Business Listings

We display publicly available business information including:

  • Business name
  • Business category
  • Contact information (phone, email, address)
  • Website URL
  • Business description

Contact Form Data

When you submit our contact form, we collect:

  • Your name
  • Email address
  • Phone number
  • Business information (if applying for a listing)
  • Any message or information you provide

How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to:

  • Provide and maintain our directory service
  • Process business listing requests
  • Respond to your inquiries and requests
  • Improve our website and services
  • Send you information about your listing (if applicable)

Information Sharing

We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. Business information listed in our directory is displayed publicly to help users find local services.

We may share information only in the following circumstances:

  • With your explicit consent
  • To comply with legal obligations
  • To protect our rights and property

Cookies and Tracking

Our website may use cookies to enhance user experience. You can control cookies through your browser settings. We do not use tracking cookies for advertising purposes.

Data Security

We implement appropriate security measures to protect your information. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

Your Rights

You have the right to:

  • Access your personal information
  • Request correction of inaccurate information
  • Request deletion of your information
  • Object to processing of your information
  • Request removal of your business listing

Third-Party Links

Our directory contains links to third-party websites (business websites). We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these external sites.

Children's Privacy

Our service is not directed to children under 16. We do not knowingly collect information from children.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes by posting the new policy on this page with an updated "Last Updated" date.

Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your rights, please contact us:

Email: info@tauntonsomerset.co.uk

Address: Taunton, Somerset, United Kingdom
